title: Nuclear power could more than triple by 2060, UN agency says
description: Rafael Grossi from the IAEA forecasts that nuclear power usage may more than triple by 2060. This increase will be driven by rising demands for electricity, especially from data centers powered by artificial intelligence. Grossi emphasized the importance of nuclear energy for energy security and its safety compared to other options. He also highlighted concerns regarding nuclear programs in Iran and North Korea, urging diplomatic efforts.
